title: MAX HUNT
description: A minecraft manhunt plugin for 1.21+ servers
body:
⚔️ Max-Hunt | Advanced Manhunt Plugin

The ultimate Minecraft manhunt experience for your server!

Max-Hunt brings the thrilling manhunt gamemode to life with advanced tracking, stunning visuals, and competitive features. Perfect for content creators, streamers, and servers looking for an action-packed survival challenge.

🎮 How It Works

Runners must survive and defeat the Ender Dragon while Hunters track them down using special compasses. The hunt spans across all dimensions - Overworld, Nether, and The End!

✨ Key Features

🧭 Advanced Tracking System

Compass Pointer - Points directly toward runners
Distance Display - Real-time block distance on screen
Particle Trail - Flame particles guide you to your target
Cross-Dimension Tracking - Shows last known position when runners change dimensions

⏱️ Headstart System

Give runners time to escape before the hunt begins
Hunters are frozen and blinded during headstart
Beautiful boss bar countdown
Configurable duration (30s, 1m, 5m, etc.)

🎯 Smart GUI Management

Easy-to-use admin panel
Hunter & runner settings GUI
Target selection menu for hunters
Tracking mode preferences

📊 Statistics & Achievements

Track kills, deaths, wins, and survival time
11 unique achievements to unlock
Post-game summary with MVP
Persistent stats across games
🏆 Achievements Include:
🩸 First Blood - Get the first kill
⚔️ Serial Killer - 5 kills in one game
🐉 Dragon Slayer - Kill the Ender Dragon
👻 Untouchable - Win without dying
⭐ Legend - Win 25 games
...and more!

🔊 Immersive Experience

Epic title announcements for major events
Custom sound effects for kills, victories, and countdowns
Spectator mode for eliminated runners
3-minute celebration time for runner victories
🔄 Automatic World Reset
Server restarts and resets worlds after each game
Configurable world list (Overworld, Nether, End)
Clean slate for every match
🛡️ Disconnect Protection
3-minute reconnect window for disconnected players
Automatic forfeit if all players leave
Fair play guaranteed

📋 Commands

Command	Description
/max-hunt	Open admin GUI
/max-hunt runner add <player>	Add a runner
/max-hunt hunter add <player>	Add a hunter
/max-hunt headstart <time>	Set headstart duration
/max-hunt start	Start the manhunt
/max-hunt stats [player]	View player statistics
/max-hunt spectate <player>	Spectate a player

⚙️ Configuration

Fully customizable through config.yml and messages.yml:

Keep inventory settings per role
Tracking mode defaults
Celebration duration
Reconnect timeout
All messages with color codes

📦 Requirements

Minecraft: 1.21 - 1.21.4
Server: Spigot, Paper, or forks
Java: 21+

🚀 Quick Start

Drop the JAR in your plugins folder
Restart your server
Add runners: /max-hunt runner add <player>
Add hunters: /max-hunt hunter add <player>
Start the hunt: /max-hunt start

💡 Perfect For

🎬 Content creators & streamers
🎮 Minigame servers
👥 Friend groups
🏆 Competitive events
